rows.repair: Fix runtime Surface.nativeLockCanvas to validate the Surface, lock a real ANativeWindow buffer, bind Canvas and retain the locked Surface reference. nativeUnlockCanvasAndPost detaches Canvas and unlocks/posts the same buffer; nativeRelease balances the retained reference. A nonzero pointer-only donor can avoid the guard but cannot prove rendering.
rows.benefit_means: possible movement of this wall, NOT a promised new lit app
validation: A successful lock produces nonzero mLockedObject and a real writable buffer; draw distinct pixels and verify posted output.
Unlock without lock and double lock continue to throw; invalid Surface propagates an error; release count remains balanced.
fd-plus refreshMapInternal no longer fails guard, then verify map pixels and t20 screenshot, not just process survival.
rows.limits: Deployed U8 lock function 0x197054 is mov x0,xzr; unlock at 0x19705c is ret. Current Westlake donor returns pointer but explicitly lacks real buffer and unlock is no-op. J guard is correct AOSP behavior, not the repair layer.

U8 already contains an identity-verified libstdc++.so SONAME-only shell; this libflipped imports no C++ symbols, so fix domain search/permitted placement rather than inventing a general C++ ABI. Then enforce successful Application.attachBaseContext/bind before Activity construction and verify app-owned enableGlobal population.
rows.benefit_means: possible movement of this wall, NOT a promised new lit app
validation: Private namespace closure resolves libflipped and the shell without unrestricted inheritance; JNI_OnLoad/Flipped initialization succeeds.
Application bind no longer logs FAILED; inspect actual X/A9Q.c writer before MainActivity DEX offset 0x46 Boolean.booleanValue.
No global ConcurrentHashMap.get default false, Boolean rewrite or suppressed attach exception; constructor completes, then obtain signed screenshot.
rows.limits: 30443 is a proven earlier bootstrap dependency failure; it plausibly prevents map initialization, but the enableGlobal writer and causation to the later NPE remain unproven. libstdc++.so is deployed globally, not globally missing.

rows.limits: Null String.isEmpty is mapped to country path at Locale.java:2539 in the exact 14r1 source. System.exit(0) follows a failed CrashActivity start, but exit caller itself was not decoded. BOOT/libcore replacement requires identity/image discipline.

rows.limits: 33705 loader failure precedes System.exit(-1) at35593; it is not proven that repairing import removes the explicit exit. AOSP function forwards to __loader_android_dlopen_ext; do not copy the wrapper without a real backend.

rows.repair: Prefer a real EGL damage extension only if advertised and callable. Otherwise adapt HWUI initExtensions and swapBuffers together: capability-aware KHR/EXT path, real full-frame eglSwapBuffers fallback with compatible buffer-age/damage bookkeeping and EGL error handling. Reuse Westlake EGL boundary fallback as a reference, not a complete HWUI gate repair.
rows.benefit_means: possible movement of this wall, NOT a promised new lit app
validation: Absent KHR/EXT uses actual full-frame swap, no fatal init assertion; supported KHR/EXT still uses correct entry point and rectangles.
Missing advertised function fails safely/falls back; EGL_BAD_SURFACE/BAD_NATIVE_WINDOW retain recovery behavior; no false extension advertisement.
Verify rendered pixels and t20; signed lit HWUI apps stay lit.
rows.limits: APK has zero arm64 native members; consumer is deployed libhwui.so, which DT_NEEDs libEGL.so. Parent reported exit code134, not an observed signal6. Filtering extensions only under WESTLAKE_EGL_TEST_NO_DAMAGE in donor does not prove that environment existed in U8.
